categories.name: Today’s menu
categories.note: Four favourites from the Keiyo Road kitchen.

categories.name: Who’s eating?
categories.note: Orders put together from the menu for one, two or the whole table. Each costs exactly what its dishes cost on their own.

categories.name: Rooms
categories.note: Standard and Deluxe rooms upstairs at Keiyo Road, from KES 3,500 a night. Tap a photo to see it full screen.

categories.name: Games
categories.note: Quizzes, party games and skill games for the table. Solo, or in teams on one phone.
